text: What may you keep about a card?
prefix: What may you keep about a card?

text: When your bank calls you, they say: your card ending 7890.
prefix: When your bank calls you, they say: your card ending 7890.

text: They never read out the whole number.
prefix: They never read out the whole number.

text: And they never ask for the three digits on the back.
prefix: And they never ask for the three digits on the back.

text: Now picture a support engineer at a shop.
prefix: Now picture a support engineer at a shop.

text: A payment failed, so the engineer pastes the buyer's whole card number into a support ticket, to ask the bank about it.
prefix: A payment failed, so the engineer pastes the buyer's whole card number into a support ticket, to ask the bank about it.

text: The number now lives in the ticket.
prefix: The number now lives in the ticket.

text: It lives in the ticket's backups, in its search, and with everyone who can read tickets.
prefix: It lives in the ticket's backups, in its search, and with everyone who can read tickets.

text: One paste has copied a card number into many places, and none of them was built to guard it.
prefix: One paste has copied a card number into many places, and none of them was built to guard it.

text: Systems should talk about cards the way your bank does on the phone.
prefix: Systems should talk about cards the way your bank does on the phone.

text: Here are the words for that.
prefix: Here are the words for that.

text: The long number on the front of the card is the PAN, the card's own number.
prefix: The long number on the front of the card is the PAN, the card's own number.

text: It is the one piece a thief needs most.
prefix: It is the one piece a thief needs most.

text: In this system it lives in one place only: the card zone, the locked room from the first lesson.
prefix: In this system it lives in one place only: the card zone, the locked room from the first lesson.

text: The three digits on the back are the card's security code.
prefix: The three digits on the back are the card's security code.

text: The card industry's rules say nobody may keep it once a payment is approved.
prefix: The card industry's rules say nobody may keep it once a payment is approved.

text: This system goes further: it never even asks for it.
prefix: This system goes further: it never even asks for it.

text: When screens and reports need to show a card, they show the masked number.
prefix: When screens and reports need to show a card, they show the masked number.

text: That is the first six digits and the last four, with stars between.
prefix: That is the first six digits and the last four, with stars between.

text: The first six digits only tell which bank gave out the card.
prefix: The first six digits only tell which bank gave out the card.

text: The last four let a person recognise their own card.
prefix: The last four let a person recognise their own card.

text: Nothing in between is shown, so the masked number cannot be used to pay.
prefix: Nothing in between is shown, so the masked number cannot be used to pay.

text: And when another system needs to point at a card, to charge it later, it keeps a card token.
prefix: And when another system needs to point at a card, to charge it later, it keeps a card token.

text: A card token is a random name the card zone gives the card.
prefix: A card token is a random name the card zone gives the card.

text: Nothing in it comes from the number.
prefix: Nothing in it comes from the number.

text: Make two tokens, and they share nothing.
prefix: Make two tokens, and they share nothing.

text: So a token tells a thief nothing about the card.
prefix: So a token tells a thief nothing about the card.

text: Three words, three rules.
prefix: Three words, three rules.

text: The PAN lives only in the card zone.
prefix: The PAN lives only in the card zone.

text: The masked number may be shown.
prefix: The masked number may be shown.

text: The token may be kept.
prefix: The token may be kept.

text: And the code on the back is never kept by anyone.
prefix: And the code on the back is never kept by anyone.

text: Now watch the product.
prefix: Now watch the product.

text: A buyer opens the bank's payment page.
prefix: A buyer opens the bank's payment page.

text: Under "Card details" sits the card form.
prefix: Under "Card details" sits the card form.

text: It asks for the number and the date on the card.
prefix: It asks for the number and the date on the card.

text: There is no box for the code on the back.
prefix: There is no box for the code on the back.

text: The buyer types the card and continues.
prefix: The buyer types the card and continues.

text: The page now shows the card as one short line: the masked number, the name of the buyer's bank, and its card network.
prefix: The page now shows the card as one short line: the masked number, the name of the buyer's bank, and its card network.

text: The full number is gone from the screen.
prefix: The full number is gone from the screen.

text: Now open the bank admin portal and its Payments page.
prefix: Now open the bank admin portal and its Payments page.

text: Each payment has a Card column.
prefix: Each payment has a Card column.

text: Every row shows a masked number: six digits, stars, four digits.
prefix: Every row shows a masked number: six digits, stars, four digits.

text: Nowhere in the portal is there a full card number.
prefix: Nowhere in the portal is there a full card number.

text: The bank's own staff see exactly what your bank says on the phone, and no more.
prefix: The bank's own staff see exactly what your bank says on the phone, and no more.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: A masked number on a screen leaks nothing useful.
prefix: A masked number on a screen leaks nothing useful.

text: A token in a database leaks nothing either, because it is only a random name.
prefix: A token in a database leaks nothing either, because it is only a random name.

text: The PAN, if it leaks, lets a thief try to spend the buyer's money.
prefix: The PAN, if it leaks, lets a thief try to spend the buyer's money.

text: So the PAN stays in one room, and everything else gets a smaller, safer word.
prefix: So the PAN stays in one room, and everything else gets a smaller, safer word.

text: This protects the buyer first, and then the shop and the bank, who would pay for the leak.
prefix: This protects the buyer first, and then the shop and the bank, who would pay for the leak.

text: Back to the support ticket.
prefix: Back to the support ticket.

text: It should have held the masked number, or the token, and never the PAN.
prefix: It should have held the masked number, or the token, and never the PAN.

text: With either one, the bank can still find the payment, and the ticket leaks nothing.
prefix: With either one, the bank can still find the payment, and the ticket leaks nothing.

text: Your bank never asks for the code on the back, and our systems never hold the PAN: they hold the masked number and the token.
prefix: Your bank never asks for the code on the back, and our systems never hold the PAN: they hold the masked number and the token.

text: Next: where a card number may live.
